exposure: Renal failure caused by diabetes or lupus
Renal failure caused by other etiologies (hypertension, focal segmental glomerular sclerosis, polycystic kidney disease, congenital hypoplastic kidneys, or neurogenic bladder)
cohort: Sixteen women receiving dialysis during pregnancy from 2012 to 2016 in a single health system.
finding: The composite neonatal morbidity was higher in women with renal failure caused by diabetes or lupus compared with other etiologies, despite similar dialysis intensity.
